items.title: 244 content elements in 10 groups
items.description_text: From heroes to footers, each built on Content Blocks 2.2 with its own backend preview.

items.title: 62 Fluid components
items.description_text: 17 atoms, 37 molecules, 4 layouts and 4 organisms, which you can use in your own templates.

items.title: 15 theme presets plus custom
items.description_text: Switchable while the site runs. A preset set on a page also applies to its subpages.

items.title: Optional integrations
items.description_text: News, Powermail, Solr, the blog, 8 Form Framework forms, Friendly Captcha and Brevo.

items.title: Demo content in one command
items.description_text: Seeders for the styleguide and the starter site. They are safe to run again and work in workspaces.
